bias.en: Bearish · back above the $203.6 October lows
bias.zh: 看空 · 重回 $203.6 十月低点上方

read.en: Coherent rose 3.8% on Nov 3 to $207.49, trading between $201.26 and $213.87. It is below the falling 5-day ($218.9), 10-day ($220.7), 30-day ($267.4) and 100-day ($302.1) and the rising 200-day ($296.6). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 12 and below zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 30 ($244.97), and RSI is 36.
read.zh: Coherent 11月3日上涨 3.8%，收于 $207.49，盘中区间 $201.26–213.87。股价位于下行的 5 日（$218.9）、10 日（$220.7）、30 日（$267.4）和 100 日均线（$302.1）以及上行的 200 日均线（$296.6）下方。MACD 自 10月12日起位于信号线下方且在零轴之下，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 10月30日起看空（$244.97），RSI 为 36。

read.en: The close reclaimed the $203.6–203.9 October lows, and the $198.65 low was not retested (Nov 3 low $201.3). Resistance is $213.9 (Nov 3 high), then $218.9–222.6 (5 and 10-day, Oct 30 high) and $245.0–246.9 (SAR, Oct 29 high). Support is $203.6–203.9, then $198.65–201.3 and $187.3–189.6 (late-December lows). A close above $214 would target $219–223; below $198.65, $187–190.

r.en: 5 and 10-day averages ($218.9–220.7); Nov 2 high $219.0; Oct 30 high $222.6

s.en: Nov 2 low $198.65; Nov 3 low $201.3; $200 round number
